reason: My regulars and Google reviews bring people in, and I already put my offers on the local WhatsApp group myself for free. I'm not handing my Instagram and my customers' DMs to a beta startup I've never heard of, even if the first month is free.
objection: Who are you? A small new team could disappear in three months, and then my page and my enquiries are tied to something that's gone. I don't know anyone who has used it.
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner nearby that I know telling me it actually brought them new customers, and seeing it work on their page first.
